name: static_proximity_calibration_contract_v1

research_target.name: requested_goal_geometric_proximity
research_target.definition: 1 iff Euclidean XY distance from query pose to the requested goal image capture position is <= 0.5 metres; otherwise 0
research_target.distance_frame: within one authenticated trajectory coordinate frame only

sampling_contract.deployment_relation: live query images compared against a separately acquired, ordered prior reference chain and an explicitly requested terminal reference
sampling_contract.query_reference_coordinate_alignment: required and currently unavailable across separate traversals
same_identity_exclusion: exclude query/reference files with identical authenticated image-byte hashes
sampling_contract.near_duplicate_policy: audit and report; do not silently remove spatially close observations because they may be valid positive proximity examples
sampling_contract.time_window_exclusion: unavailable; admitted training records have no timestamps, so no seconds-based cutoff is permitted
sampling_contract.goal_sampling: must be fixed against a deployment-faithful reference-bank specification before any descriptor extraction; no eligible bank is currently bound

candidate_feature_contract.input: exactly four time-ordered query-history rows by N ordered reference-node similarity values, all finite, with node identities bound
candidate_feature_contract.ordered_score: S(j) = mean over k=0..3 of similarity[k][max(0,j-k)]
features: alias_margin = terminal_score - max(S(j)) over nodes before the explicit terminal reference window
candidate_feature_contract.window_status: UNRESOLVED; must be determined from an authenticated deployment reference-chain contract, not fitted against exposed pilot or future evaluation outcomes
candidate_feature_contract.known_semantic_caveat: a nonterminal node may itself be within the 0.5 m positive region; its score cannot be treated as a negative label, and the margin is only a candidate predictor to compare against terminal_score alone
candidate_feature_contract.encoder_status: UNRESOLVED; no provenance-qualified pairwise similarity encoder/checkpoint contract is established by the existing fixed RAVEL graph or native PlaceNav/ULVN interface qualifications

groups_and_exposure.unit_for_partitioning: layout group, with source trajectory and all frames/references/duplicates kept together
groups_and_exposure.reason: no defensible disjoint allocation exists in the current admitted data: the adapted encoder has seen training records, existing development/retired-test groups are exposed and have documented appearance overlap, and specified future held-out layouts are uncollected and forbidden for calibration

comparison_and_measurement.comparator_2: terminal_score-only logistic probability map using the same fit groups and weighting
comparison_and_measurement.candidate: two-feature logistic probability map using terminal_score and alias_margin, same groups and weighting
comparison_and_measurement.weighting: each episode contributes equal total fitting weight; this does not make episodes or layouts independent
comparison_and_measurement.threshold_status: BLOCKED; no downstream false-stop/missed-arrival trade-off or qualified motion policy supplies an operating criterion
comparison_and_measurement.alias_hard_coverage: NOT ESTABLISHED; geometry-only records and current metadata cannot establish visually confusing wrong-location examples

budgets.future_budget_status: NOT SET: eligible groups, encoder/checkpoint, reference-bank contract and operating criterion are unresolved; assigning a resource cap now would not define a valid experiment

execution_gates: authenticate a deployment-faithful ordered query/reference acquisition and alignment contract
select and authenticate encoder source, checkpoint, preprocessing and similarity scale
freeze terminal reference window and missing/invalid-score handling
identify permitted layout-disjoint fit, threshold-selection and assessment groups before feature extraction
define an operational probability/threshold objective without calling geometric proximity successful arrival or safe STOP
independently establish whether visually confusing wrong-location examples are represented
obtain a separate finite resource decision and protocol review
prohibited_inputs: future held-out layout geometry or evaluation outcomes
live ground-truth pose, depth, simulator state or controller/contact feedback
